name: How long does deck board replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does deck board replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of deck board replacement depends on the size and complexity of your deck. A small, straightforward deck might take a few days, while larger decks with intricate designs or extensive repairs could take a week or more. Factors such as weather conditions and the availability of materials also influence the timeline. We will provide an estimated project timeline after assessing your deck's specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on deck size and complexity, typically ranging from a few days to over a week.
